# `armada service`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armada.md)

Services are programs such as a CI system. Each has certificates of its own
and holds roles like a user; `armada role list` shows the roles and who
holds them.

Also: `services`.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada service create`](#armada-service-create) | Create a service |
| [`armada service credentials`](#armada-service-credentials) | Write a client config for a service |
| [`armada service delete`](#armada-service-delete) | Delete a service and revoke every certificate of it |
| [`armada service list`](#armada-service-list) | List services and their roles |
| [`armada service renew`](#armada-service-renew) | Renew the certificate of a service's client config |
| [`armada service show`](#armada-service-show) | Show a service's roles and allowed node labels |
| [`armada service update`](#armada-service-update) | Replace the node labels a service's apps may require |

## `armada service create`

Create a service, a tool that uses the API, with a first role (in --space
for viewer, deployer, and admin). Give it a client config with
`armada service credentials`, and more roles with
`armada role grant`.

```
armada service create NAME [--role ROLE [--space P]] [--allow-label KEY=VALUE]... [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
armada service create ci --role deployer --space shop
armada service create portal --role space-creator
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--allow-label stringArray` | a node label KEY=VALUE its apps' placement may require (repeat for more) |
| `--role string` | a first role: viewer, deployer, admin (with --space), space-creator, or cluster-admin |

## `armada service credentials`

Make a key here and a certificate for service NAME (90 days), and write a
client config to FILE (mode 0600). The tool uses it with `armada --config
FILE`, or the API with its PEM fields, and renews it with
`armada service renew --config FILE`. Its other certificates stay valid
until it renews or is deleted.

```
armada service credentials NAME -o FILE [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | client config file to create |
| `--ssh ssh -W` | reach the servers through this SSH host ([user@]host or a ~/.ssh/config alias): ssh -W to their private addresses, mTLS inside |

## `armada service delete`

Revoke every certificate of the service, at once and on every server, and
take its roles back. You cannot delete yourself.

```
armada service delete NAME --yes [flags]
```

Also: `rm`.

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--yes` | confirm deleting |

## `armada service list`

List services and their roles.

```
armada service list [flags]
```

Also: `ls`.

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

## `armada service renew`

Run by the tool with its own client config (--config or ARMADA_CONFIG): get
a new 90-day certificate for a new key and rewrite the file. Every other
certificate of the service is revoked; the one in the file is replaced.

```
armada service renew --config FILE
```

## `armada service show`

Show a service's roles and allowed node labels.

```
armada service show NAME [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

## `armada service update`

Replace the node label values the apps a service deploys may name in
placement.require (armada.* labels are always allowed): restricted nodes
can be kept for some spaces. Roles change with `armada role grant` and `armada role revoke`.

```
armada service update NAME (--allow-label KEY=VALUE... | --clear-labels) [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--allow-label stringArray` | a node label KEY=VALUE its apps' placement may require (repeat for more) |
| `--clear-labels` | allow no node labels |
